nguon: 💬 Giao tiếp · Bản thân & gia đình · bài tự soạn
L: Hi, I'm Mai. Where are you from?
I'm from Da Nang, but I grew up in Hue.
Oh nice! I was born in Hue too.
Really? What a small world! When did you move here?
About five years ago, for university.
Me too. I miss the food back home, though.
Same here. I go back every Tet to see my family.
Lucky you. My hometown is a long way from here.
Maybe twice a year. It takes ten hours by bus.
Wow, that's far! Maybe we can travel together next Tet.
Sounds like a plan! Let's swap numbers.

exq.why: “I'm from Da Nang, but I grew up in Hue.” = quê Đà Nẵng nhưng lớn lên ở Huế.

exq.q: Why did Mai move to the city?
How long does it take Tom to go home by bus?
exq.why: “It takes ten hours by bus.” = đi xe buýt mất mười tiếng.

exq.q: How often does Tom visit his hometown?
exq.why: “Maybe twice a year.” = chắc hai lần một năm.
